draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Jules,

Thanks for the update — glad the first week has gone well, and great to hear the onboarding flow felt smooth (your ticket on that is closed out on our side).

Since you've got your first project going and an invite out, the next useful step is getting work actually flowing inside it — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. If it's helpful, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and walk through how your team's work could be structured in Wrenfield.

Either way, I'm here if anything comes up.

Best,
Nadia
